parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query, in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ. The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: IPList
parameters.description: The IP address or IP range to query.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query, in ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
